---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspection Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(lubridate)

data("rest_inspec")

# Data cleaning
inspection_clean =
  rest_inspec |>
  rename(borough = boro) |>
  mutate(
    inspection_date = as.Date(inspection_date),
    year = year(inspection_date),
    month = floor_date(inspection_date, "month")
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(inspection_date),
    !is.na(score),
    score >= 0,
    score <= 100,
    !is.na(borough),
    borough != "0"
  )

# Sampling
inspection_sample =
  inspection_clean |>
  group_by(borough) |>
  slice_sample(n = 4000) |>
  ungroup()

# Summary data
borough_score =
  inspection_sample |>
  group_by(borough) |>
  summarize(
    average_score = mean(score),
    median_score = median(score),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_data =
  inspection_clean |>
  count(month)
```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### 1 Bar Plot: Average Inspection Score by Borough

```{r}
plot_ly(
  borough_score,
  x = ~borough,
  y = ~average_score,
  type = "bar",
  color = ~borough,
  text = ~paste(
    "Average score:", round(average_score, 2),
    "<br>Median score:", median_score,
    "<br>Records:", n
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Average Inspection Score by Borough",
    xaxis = list(title = "Borough"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Average Inspection Score"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

### 2 Line Plot: Monthly Inspection Records

```{r}
plot_ly(
  monthly_data,
  x = ~month,
  y = ~n,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers"
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Monthly Inspection Records",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Records")
  )
```
Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### 3 Histogram Plot: Distribution of Inspection Scores

```{r}
plot_ly(
  inspection_sample,
  x = ~score,
  type = "histogram",
  nbinsx = 30
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Distribution of Inspection Scores",
    xaxis = list(title = "Inspection Score"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Frequency")
  )
```
